evidence.whyNotSweepMeasurement: The control renders only while the substrate:docker-vm-wedged condition is open, which no sweep fixture produces, so a sweep of /portfolio/product/[id]/health would measure the page without the control. The placement was decided among three options instead.
evidence.notes: The panel adds one control (a danger-variant confirmed button) and nothing else. It is mounted on the portal Health tab only while the VM is reported wedged; the attention card for that condition links to it. The default view is unchanged when the VM is healthy.
